# AURELIA — Contemporary Luxury Villa Residence

> A bespoke architectural sanctuary where horizontal geometry, natural travertine, warm oak, and floor-to-ceiling glass unite with panoramic Mediterranean landscape.

## Property Overview
- **Name**: AURELIA
- **Property Type**: Single Family Luxury Architectural Residence / Private Villa Estate
- **Architectural Style**: Contemporary Organic Modernism with horizontal stone cantilevers and floor-to-ceiling glass threshold walls
- **Levels**: 2 Floors of residential living
- **Built Area**: Approximately 900 m² (gross interior & covered terrace living)
- **Land / Plot Size**: Approximately 4,000 m² private landscaped parcel
- **Bedrooms**: 5 Private En-suite Suites
- **Bathrooms**: 6 Bathrooms (including powder rooms & master spa suite)

## Architectural & Material Identity
- **Primary Facade**: Hand-selected honed Roman travertine stone
- **Glazing**: Floor-to-ceiling slimline bronze-black aluminum thermal-break glass systems with motorized sliding thresholds
- **Cabinetry & Paneling**: Warm quarter-sawn natural oak wall claddings and bespoke custom millwork
- **Interior Flooring**: Large-format honed limestone and seamless travertine continuing through indoor-outdoor transitions
- **Metal Accents**: Architectural bronze and matte obsidian details

## Spatial Program & Key Amenities
- **Living Sanctuary**: Double-height open-plan lounge with architectural linear fireplace and panoramic sliding glass walls
- **Designer Kitchen**: Sculptural bookmatched marble kitchen island, integrated premium appliances, hidden prep pantry, and dining bar
- **Master Suite**: Expansive master bedroom sanctuary with panoramic sunrise vistas, private terrace access, and bespoke acoustic paneling
- **Walk-in Dressing Room**: Boutique-grade dressing suite with natural oak cabinetry, smoked glass vitrines, integrated ambient LED illumination, and freestanding stone accessory island
- **Outdoor Living & Pool Terrace**:
  - Heated outdoor infinity swimming pool with zero-edge horizon reflection
  - Sunken conversational fire lounge set into the pool terrace
  - Covered alfresco dining pavilion with outdoor summer kitchen
  - Landscaped Mediterranean gardens with specimen olive trees, fragrant lavender, and ornamental grasses
- **Wellness & Privacy**: Dedicated wellness area, private security perimeter, smart home automation integration, and multi-vehicle private motor court

## Location Context
- **Setting**: Elevated private hillside with panoramic natural landscape views
- **Proximity**: Minutes from private coastal beaches, Michelin-starred fine dining, international private schools, championship golf, and convenient regional airport access.
